approach: Computer Software Assurance (executable evidence, not screenshots)

cases.title: Subject enrolment and form data entry OQ-FORM-01: enrolment sets a server timestamp and is audited
Subject enrolment and form data entry OQ-FORM-02: SECURITY — a client-supplied timestamp is ignored (server time wins)
Subject enrolment and form data entry OQ-FORM-03: invalid form data is rejected (422) and nothing is written
Subject enrolment and form data entry OQ-FORM-04: valid update diff-audits only changed fields with a reason
Subject enrolment and form data entry OQ-FORM-05: an update without a reason for change is rejected (422)
Subject enrolment and form data entry OQ-FORM-06: SECURITY — there is no API path to modify an audit entry
Authentication, password policy, lockout, session OQ-AUTH-01: valid login returns a session JWT with configured expiry
Authentication, password policy, lockout, session OQ-AUTH-02: successful login is recorded in the audit trail
Authentication, password policy, lockout, session OQ-AUTH-03: wrong password is rejected and audited as a failure
Authentication, password policy, lockout, session OQ-AUTH-04: account locks after the configured number of failures
Authentication, password policy, lockout, session OQ-AUTH-05: password change rejects a weak password (policy enforced)
Authentication, password policy, lockout, session OQ-AUTH-06: password change rejects reuse of the current password
Authentication, password policy, lockout, session OQ-AUTH-07: an expired session token is rejected
Authentication, password policy, lockout, session OQ-AUTH-08: a request with no token is rejected
Query workflow OQ-QRY-01: a Monitor can raise a query (open + history + audit)
Query workflow OQ-QRY-02: full lifecycle raise -> respond -> close with separation of duties
Query workflow OQ-QRY-03: an Investigator cannot raise a query (403 — not their authority)
Query workflow OQ-QRY-04: an Investigator cannot close a query (403 — separation of duties)
Electronic signatures — binding, locking, tamper-evidence OQ-SIG-01: signing requires correct re-authentication (wrong password → 401, no signature)
Electronic signatures — binding, locking, tamper-evidence OQ-SIG-02: a valid signature captures printed name, UTC time, meaning, and a content hash
Electronic signatures — binding, locking, tamper-evidence OQ-SIG-03: signing locks the record (status signed, locked=true)
Electronic signatures — binding, locking, tamper-evidence OQ-SIG-04: signature verifies as VALID immediately after signing
Electronic signatures — binding, locking, tamper-evidence OQ-SIG-05: invalid meaning is rejected
Electronic signatures — binding, locking, tamper-evidence OQ-SIG-06: the Signature collection is append-only (cannot be altered or deleted)
Amendment workflow on signed records OQ-AMD-01: SECURITY — editing a signed record via normal update is blocked (409)
Amendment workflow on signed records OQ-AMD-02: amending requires a reason for change
Amendment workflow on signed records OQ-AMD-03: a valid amendment bumps version, re-opens the record, and is audited
Amendment workflow on signed records OQ-AMD-04: after amendment the prior signature no longer verifies (tamper-evident)
Dataset export with integrity checksum OQ-EXP-01: DataManager can export; files + checksum manifest returned
Dataset export with integrity checksum OQ-EXP-02: recomputing the checksum of the exported file matches the manifest
Dataset export with integrity checksum OQ-EXP-03: an export is recorded in the audit trail
Dataset export with integrity checksum OQ-EXP-04: SECURITY — an Investigator cannot export the dataset (403 + logged)
RBAC authority checks (server-side enforcement) OQ-RBAC-01: permission matrix returns expected authority decisions
RBAC authority checks (server-side enforcement) OQ-RBAC-02: Investigator (authorized) can write form data
RBAC authority checks (server-side enforcement) OQ-RBAC-03: SECURITY — Monitor privilege escalation via direct API is blocked (403) and logged
RBAC authority checks (server-side enforcement) OQ-RBAC-04: SECURITY — a token with a tampered role does not grant access
RBAC authority checks (server-side enforcement) OQ-RBAC-05: a token signed with the wrong secret is rejected
Soft delete only — no hard deletes anywhere OQ-SD-01: new documents default to not-deleted
Soft delete only — no hard deletes anywhere OQ-SD-02: hard delete pathways all throw
Soft delete only — no hard deletes anywhere OQ-SD-03: softDelete sets metadata and hides from default reads
Audit trail is append-only and complete OQ-AUD-01: writeAudit persists an event with a server timestamp
Audit trail is append-only and complete OQ-AUD-02: AuditEvent cannot be updated via any pathway
Audit trail is append-only and complete OQ-AUD-03: AuditEvent cannot be deleted via any pathway
Audit trail is append-only and complete OQ-AUD-04: diffAndAudit writes one event per changed field only
Application bootstrap OQ-APP-01: health endpoint responds ok
Application bootstrap OQ-APP-02: unknown route returns structured 404
Application bootstrap OQ-APP-03: config singleton seeds from defaults and is reused
Edit-check engine OQ-EC-01: demographics requires DOB and sex
Edit-check engine OQ-EC-02: demographics rejects a future date of birth
Edit-check engine OQ-EC-03: vitals range checks catch out-of-range systolic
Edit-check engine OQ-EC-04: vitals cross-field requires systolic > diastolic
Edit-check engine OQ-EC-05: valid vitals produce no errors
Edit-check engine OQ-EC-06: adverse event end date cannot precede start date
Edit-check engine OQ-EC-07: an ongoing adverse event cannot have an end date
